events.content: Should we cache the JWTs in redis so we stop hitting the auth service on every request?

Caching would work, but these tokens expire after ninety seconds, so a cache would be stale almost immediately and we'd need invalidation logic anyway. A simpler approach: keep calling the auth service, and only refresh a token when a request actually comes back 401. The auth service call is cheap; the complexity of a cache is not. Let's go with refresh-on-401 instead of caching.
